# v2026.11.17

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.17.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.17.md).

This release covers **2 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Every error in Flow carries Copy error: a danger toast, a note and an alert copy the page, the failed call, its status, its code and the ids, ready to paste to an agent. The screen's words are not copied, so no contact, clinic or patient name leaves Flow. ([#536](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/536))
- A job's Fix tab has Copy prompt beside Accept change and Recheck. It names the rule or check that stops the job, with its link, and changed lines show in red. ([#536](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/536))

## Changes

- One shared prompt shape for an invoice, a job fix, a Reconcile gap, a price row and any error. ([#536](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/536))
- Contacts uses the shared list head, window and columns, the same as the other lists. ([#536](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/536))

## Fixes

- Copy error on an alert and the page-title help link are 44px touch targets on a phone. ([#536](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/536))

## Contribution record

[CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.17.md](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/blob/main/CHANGELOG/records/2026.11.17.md) lists every pull request in this release once, with its related issues and thanks.
